content.text: AV | Global Defense Technology across Air, Land, Sea, Space, and Cyber Integrated all-domain battle-tested solutions for today’s battlefield. AV is a global defense technology leader delivering battlefield proven systems and next-generation capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. From loitering munitions and autonomous robotic systems to counter-UAS, directed energy, cyber, and mission command systems, AV's proven solutions are based on learnings from over 50,000 autonomous systems delivered to the battlefield to meet evolving threats head-on. Where Proven Systems Meet the Future of Defense Autonomous Systems & Solutions AV combines cutting-edge innovation with its deep domain expertise and multiple decades of battle-proven experience to deliver integrated capabilities that meet the evolving demands of today’s battlefield. We execute with urgency, engineer with precision, and affordably scale with high reliability—bringing together the talent, infrastructure, and technology needed to meet today’s missions and shape what comes next. With a legacy of delivering when it matters and a robust pipeline built for the future, AV is defining the next era of defense technology. MacCready Works Built to Make the Rules of the Battlefield MacCready Works is AV’s dedicated innovation engine—where software, autonomy, sensors, and platform technologies converge to shape the future of defense. From rapid prototypes to fielded systems, this is where breakthrough ideas become battlefield advantage. Learn About MacCready Works AV_Halo Unified Software Platform for Next-Gen Operational Advantage Integrated with AV’s disruptive autonomous systems and precision munitions, AV_Halo delivers full-battlefield dominance—Detect, Decide, Deliver capability sets—with speed, precision, and unstoppable operational advantage.​ Learn About AV_Halo AV In the News Some missions stay classified. These headlines don’t. While much of our work remains behind closed doors, AV continues to earn attention across defense, technology, and global media. Explore the latest stories on our strategy, systems, and impact. About AV AV was founded by visionary aerospace engineer Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr. and has spent more than five decades redefining what’s possible when customer understanding and emerging technologies intersect. AV delivers integrated defense technology solutions, that are innovative, ensure mission outcomes, and create strategic advantage across every domain of modern warfare. Learn what drives us—our people, principles, and the mission that brings them together.
